description:
NGAPHAMBI KOKUTHI UTHENGE — OKUNCIKE KUKHO I-DAWNLIST

I-Dawnlist isebenzisa i-AI ekhiqizayo ukufunda izikhangiso zemisebenzi, ukuzihlola ngokumelene nomhlahlandlela wakho, kanye nokubhala imiyalezo yakho. Isebenza ngokhiye wakho we-API ka-Anthropic. Kuzodingeka ube nawo, futhi u-Anthropic ukukhokhisa ngqo ngalokho i-Dawnlist ekufundayo — imvamisa kuba imali encane nje ngenyanga uma usebenzisa ngokujwayelekile. Ukudala ukhiye kuthatha imizuzu embalwa ku-console.anthropic.com. I-Dawnlist ayithathi ingxenye yalutho futhi ayengezi mali eyengeziwe. Uma ungathanda ukungabambi ukhiye we-API, lolu hlelo lokusebenza alukulungele.

I-Dawnlist ingumbhaliso, othengwa kuwebhusayithi yethu. Ngenkathi isebenza, ifunda izifunzo zemisebenzi ngokwakho nsuku zonke, futhi lokho kufunda kubiza imali nsuku zonke — ngakho intengo yayo imele indleko zayo. Akukho lutho olugodliwe kwababhalisile futhi akukho nkokhelo yesibili ngaphakathi kohlelo lokusebenza.

I-Dawnlist ifunda izifunzo zemisebenzi zomhlaba wonke njalo ekuseni, ihlole sonke isikhangiso ngokumelene nomhlahlandlela wokufaneleka ewakha nawe, bese ikunika uhlu olufingqiwe olukleliswe ngaphambi kokuthi uqede ikhofi lakho.

Ayilokothi ithumele lutho. Wonke umyalezo ewubhalayo uyi-draft oyivula bese uyithumela ngohlelo lwakho lwe-imeyili. Lowo umkhawulo owenzelwe ngamabomu, hhayi ukukhinyabezeka: usalokhu ungumuntu onquma ukuthi kuphumani ngaphansi kwegama lakho.


OKUYENZAYO

Uhlu olufingqiwe njalo ekuseni
I-Dawnlist ishanela izifunzo zemisebenzi, ikhiphe lokho osuvele ukubonile noma osuvele ukwenqabile, bese ifunda lokho okusele. Uthola uhlu olufingqiwe olukleliswe kanye nezizathu — futhi, okungajwayelekile, nokwenqatshwe kuyabonakala, ngakunye nesizathu sokuthi kungani kubekelwe eceleni. Akukho lutho olunyamalala buthule.

Ibonisa umsebenzi wayo
Ukusebenza ngakunye kubonisa lonke uhlelo lokuhlunga: zingaki izikhangiso ezishanelwe, ezisuswe izimpinda, ezihlungwe, ezihloliwe nezikalwe. Inani alilokothi liboniswe ngaphandle kwalokho elikushiya ngaphandle, ngakho ungabona njalo ukuthi uhlu olufingqiwe lwezine luvela kanjani ekushanelweni kwenkulungwane.

Ifunda ukwahlulela kwakho, hhayi nje amagama akho angukhiye
Ngaphambi kokusebenza kokuqala, i-Dawnlist ikubonisa izikhangiso eziyishumi ezisebenzayo kanye nesinqumo sayo ngayinye. Lapho ungavumelani, uyitshele ukuthi imusho muni obungayenza ifike esiphethweni esifanele, futhi lowo musho ungena emhlahlandlela wakho. Konke ukulungisa okulandelayo kwenza okufanayo. Yile ngxenye eyenza ibe yakho kunokuba ibe eyejwayelekile.

Isilandeli esibonisa iqiniso
Yonke inkampani oyilandelayo, kanye nesigaba sayo, irekhodi lobufakazi balokho okwathunyelwa ngempela, nalokho okulandelayo okumele kwenziwe. Izinsuku zokulandelela zibalwa kusukela kukuxhumana okurekhodile ngempela — akungeni nhlobo enkambini endala — futhi azilokothi ziwele ngoMsombuluko noma ngoLwesihlanu.

Ama-draft ngezwi lakho, ngolimi lwakho
I-Dawnlist ibhala ukulandelela ngesitayela solimi osilusebenzisa ngempela, esifundwe kumiyalezo yakho othunyelwe oyengeza ngokwakho. Isebenza ngezilimi ezingamashumi amahlanu. Futhi wonke amazwi angamaqiniso avela ekhasini lamaqiniso elakhiwe kusuka kuma-CV akho; lapho ubufakazi bungasekeli isitatimende, ishiya isikhala esibonakalayo kunokuqamba okuthile.


OKUNGAKWENZI

Ayithumeli. Awukho nhlobo ikhodi yokuthumela kulolu hlelo lokusebenza.
Ayifundi ibhokisi lakho leposi. Awekho amaphasiwedi, akukho ukufinyelela kwibhokisi lokungenayo, akukho lutho okumele uluxhume.
Ayifaki isicelo egameni lakho, futhi ayigcwalisi mafomu, futhi ayithumeli myalezo kunoma ubani esikhundleni sakho.
Ayihlwithi idatha emabhodini emisebenzi.

Uma ufuna uhlelo lokusebenza oluthumela izicelo eziyikhulu ngenkathi ulele, akulona leli. I-Dawnlist ingeyabantu abafuna ukuxhumana okumbalwa, okuhlolwe kangcono, nabahlose ukuma ngemuva kwakho konke abakwenzayo.


INDLELA IDATHA YAKHO EPHATHWA NGAYO

Ama-CV akho, umhlahlandlela wakho kanye nesilandeli sakho ahlala kumshini wakho.

Izincazelo zemisebenzi kanye nomhlahlandlela wakho wokufaneleka zithunyelwa ku-API ka-Anthropic ukuze zihlolwe, ngaphansi KOKHIYE WAKHO WE-API — ngakho lelo thelathelo liphakathi kwakho no-Anthropic, futhi i-Dawnlist ayihlanganyeli kulo. Ukucinga imisebenzi kudlula kusevisi yezifunzo ye-Dawnlist, erekhoda izibalo zokusetshenziswa futhi engalokothi irekhode okuqukethwe.

Imininingwane egcwele itholakala kunqubomgomo yobumfihlo.


UKUBIKA LOKHO OKUBHALWA YI-DAWNLIST

Ngenxa yokuthi izinqumo nama-draft e-Dawnlist akhiqizwa yi-AI, kukhona indlela yokusitshela lapho ikhiqiza okuthile okungafanele, okucasulayo noma okungalungile ngokusobala. Vula Izilungiselelo bese usebenzisa u-"Bika okuqukethwe okukhiqizwe yi-AI", noma bhalela ku-Apps@spencerfields.com. Umbiko ubhalwa ngumuntu, awuthunyelwa uhlelo lokusebenza — ukuchaza okwenzekile kwanele.


UKUQALA

Ukulungiselela kuthatha cishe ihora elingxenye: engeza ama-CV akho, phendula imibuzo embalwa mayelana nalokho okufunayo, bese ulungisa i-Dawnlist kwizikhangiso eziyishumi zangempela. Emva kwalokho isebenza njalo ekuseni.


OKUKHOKHELAYO

Umbhaliso owodwa, nohlelo lokusebenza lonke. Akukho lutho oluvalelwe ngemuva kwenkokhelo yesibili futhi akukho sici esigodliwe.

Isifunzo semisebenzi sifakiwe. Ukucinga kubiza imali yangempela zonke izinsuku i-Dawnlist isebenza, futhi yilokho umbhaliso okukhokhelayo.

Ukufunda kanye nokubhala ama-draft kwehlukene, futhi ukhokhela u-Anthropic ngqo ngokhiye wakho we-API. Ekusetshenzisweni okuvamile lokho kuvame ukuba imali encane nje ngenyanga. Wena uphethe ukhiye, wena ubona ukusetshenziswa, futhi ungawuhoxisa noma nini. I-Dawnlist ayilokothi ibone leyo bhili futhi ayithathi ngxenye kuyo.

Kungani ukhiye wakho kunowethu: ama-CV akho, umhlahlandlela wakho wokufaneleka kanye nezincazelo zemisebenzi i-Dawnlist ezifundayo kungumlando wakho womsebenzi. Ukukuthumela ngengqalasizinda yethu kungasenza umgcini werekhodi lomsebenzi wakho. Ukhiye wakho usho ukuthi lelo thelathelo liphakathi kwakho no-Anthropic, futhi thina asiyona ingxenye yalo.
